cases.title: Add new bookmark to hierarchy
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark is successfully added.

cases.title: Add new bookmark into a specific location
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark is added into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Delete Bookmarks from File
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks are properly deleted from the bookmarks file.

cases.title: Remove Deleted Bookmarks from Display
cases.description: Verify that deleted bookmarks are no longer displayed from all access points.

cases.title: Add bookmark to the personal toolbar
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully added to the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Delete bookmark from the personal toolbar
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully deleted from the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Insert new bookmark folder into bookmarks hierarchy
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark folder can be successfully inserted into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Double-click bookmark to launch browser window
cases.description: Verify that double-clicking on a bookmark causes it to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Validate Default Bookmarks File Links
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks within the default bookmarks file that is packaged with the browser are valid links.

cases.title: Save changes to a bookmark item
cases.description: Verify that changes made to a bookmark item are successfully saved.

cases.title: Preserve bookmark item integrity
cases.description: Verify that changes to a bookmark item are saved without loss of item integrity.

cases.title: Delete Bookmarks Folder
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks folder is successfully deleted.

cases.title: Add bookmarks separators
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks separators can be successfully added.

cases.title: Delete bookmarks separators
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks separators can be successfully deleted.

cases.title: Save Bookmarks Changes Over Restart
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks changes are successfully saved and retained after an application restart.

cases.title: Save Bookmarks Changes Over Crash
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks changes are successfully saved and retained after an application crash.

cases.title: Negative view properties execution for bookmarks
cases.description: Verify that view properties execution yields negative results or is restricted for bookmarks.

cases.title: Negative view properties execution for folders
cases.description: Verify that view properties execution yields negative results or is restricted for folders.

cases.title: Negative view properties execution for separators
cases.description: Verify that view properties execution yields negative results or is restricted for separators.

cases.title: Rename bookmark inline
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be renamed directly inline.

cases.title: Rename bookmark without properties dialog
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark is renamed inline without having to use the bookmarks properties dialog.

cases.title: Find Bookmark Using User-Defined Custom Keyword
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be successfully found using a user-defined custom keyword.

cases.title: Sort bookmarks per column
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks are successfully sorted per column.

cases.title: Reverse-sort bookmarks per column
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks are successfully reverse-sorted per column.

cases.title: Resize bookmark columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be resized.

cases.title: Show and hide more entries via column resizing
cases.description: Verify that resizing bookmark columns shows or hides more of the entries.

cases.title: Show Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be explicitly showed.

cases.title: Hide Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be explicitly hidden.

cases.title: Delete Several Bookmarks at One Time
cases.description: Verify that several bookmarks can be selected and deleted simultaneously in a single action.

cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark item onto itself
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto itself.

cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark item onto its immediate parent
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto its immediate parent.

cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark item onto its immediate child
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto its immediate child.

opinions.feedback: The test cases successfully cover all the explicit requirements and their operational boundaries without any blockers or coverage gaps.

analysis.analysis: R-001: Multiple behaviors. Atomic behaviors: Add a new bookmark; Place it into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy. R-002: Multiple behaviors. Atomic behaviors: Delete bookmarks from bookmarks file; Remove bookmarks from display across all access points. R-003: Multiple behaviors. Atomic behaviors: Add bookmarks from the personal toolbar; Delete bookmarks from the personal toolbar. R-004: Single straightforward acceptance criterion (Normal scenario only). R-005: Single straightforward acceptance criterion (Normal scenario only). R-006: Single straightforward acceptance criterion (Normal scenario only). R-007: Multiple behaviors. Atomic behaviors: Save changes to a bookmark item; Preserve item integrity without loss. R-008: Single straightforward acceptance criterion (Normal scenario only). R-009: Multiple behaviors. Atomic behaviors: Add bookmarks separators; Delete bookmarks separators. R-010: Multiple behaviors. Atomic behaviors: Save bookmarks changes over restart; Save bookmarks changes over crash. R-011: Multiple behaviors with negative condition. Atomic behaviors: Execute view properties for bookmarks (negative); Execute view properties for folders (negative); Execute view properties for separators (negative). R-012: Multiple behaviors. Atomic behaviors: Rename bookmarks inline; Perform rename without using the bookmarks properties dialog. R-013: Single straightforward acceptance criterion (Normal scenario only). R-014: Multiple behaviors. Atomic behaviors: Sort bookmarks per column; Reverse-sort bookmarks per column. R-015: Multiple behaviors. Atomic behaviors: Resize bookmark columns; Show/hide more of entries via resizing. R-016: Multiple behaviors. Atomic behaviors: Show bookmark columns; Hide bookmark columns. R-017: Single straightforward acceptance criterion (Normal scenario only). R-018: Multiple behaviors with boundary/abnormal constraints. Atomic behaviors: Prevent dropping a bookmark item onto itself; Prevent dropping a bookmark item onto its immediate parent; Prevent dropping a bookmark item onto its immediate child.
